recognize_zh: 淋巴結內多個濾泡，中心為小而深染的淋巴球，外圍被較大、淡染的細胞包圍（B），與一般濾泡「中心淡、外圍深」相反；外圍大細胞 CD10 與 BCL2 陽性（D、E），CD21 顯示濾泡樹突網存在（G），BCL2 FISH 異常，符合反轉型濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: lymph node with multiple nodules extending into perinodal fat
Panel B: follicle with a central dark zone of small lymphocytes surrounded by a broad rim of larger pale cells (reverse pattern)
Panel C: CD20 positive throughout with darker staining of the central small cell aggregate
Panels D-E: CD10 and strong BCL2 positivity in the neoplastic cells, including the pale peripheral zone
Panel F: weak/partial BCL6 nuclear staining; Panel G: CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks in multiple nodules
Panel H: BCL2 FISH with fusion/split signals indicating BCL2 rearrangement
describe_en: Lymph node section (A) shows a nodular proliferation with nodules extending into perinodal adipose tissue. At higher power (B) the nodules show a reverse pattern: a central aggregate of small dark lymphocytes surrounded by a wide peripheral zone of larger, paler cells with more abundant cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells are CD20 positive (C) and express CD10 (D) and strong BCL2 (E), with weaker BCL6 (F); CD21 (G) highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and FISH (H) demonstrates a BCL2 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with a reverse (inverted) follicular pattern.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Pale marginal zone cells also surround residual follicles but are CD10 negative and lack BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantle zones surround reactive germinal centers but are CD5+/cyclin D1+ and CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with marginal zone hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Germinal centers are BCL2 negative with polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and there is no BCL2 rearrangement.
Nodules contain scattered CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells within expanded mantle zones rather than a CD10+/BCL2+ monoclonal B-cell population.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL2, BCL6, CD21; FISH: BCL2
